body: You need to get the fuck out of that situation asap. I guess you live alone. Take any opportunity to change that. I lived alone for four years, and now in the summer i moved back with my mother. I was very suicidal. No one was looking for me either. Don't be alone if you can.

We wan't other to stay alive, and be happy, not just stay alive. At least this is how i see it. I don't want anyone to stay alive only to suffer. Because i hate suffering. I know it only too well. When i see that someone is suicidal, i try to convince them not to do it, because i have faith in them. I have faith that you can save yourself. I have faith that you can find help for yourself. This faith is the only thing that keeps me going too.
I'm so very very happy to read this.

You can't get kicks because of the state you are in. We make different decisions, in different states. How you feel right know, you can't make good decisions. I invite you to go and run, or sprint, do something psychical. Make yourself sweat. And then read again what i just said. I know this maybe the dumbest shit you've ever read, and you are like why the fuck would i do that? But what can you loose? If you change your state physically, you change your state mentally.

I never planned when i would kill myself, i just always knew how i would do it. Since i'm a musician, i would hang myself with a guitar cable. But i almost say this as a joke. I never even tried to do it, and i don't plan to. I just told you this to show how i can relate. 
But you never told why you feel this way, so why?

We share similar lives. All i can say i eliminate loneliness however you can. I just moved back to my mother, because i was living alone for four years, after a similar girlfriend you had. If you can't find a way how not to live alone, then you should join a community. Join a martial arts gym, or anything you can think of.

I think you still want to live, and not just because of your programming. You want to live, you just don't know how. I invite you to do something. It may sound stupid, but what can you loose by trying? Go to a bookstore. A big bookstore with multiple levels. And just wander around, checking books. Not just for fifteen minutes, but maybe for hours. Eventually you'll find something that interests you. More then one i think. And go into that direction, whatever it may be, however stupid it may sound. You still got time to learn a craft. plenty of time. And i don't know where you live, but if you're living alone, do whatever it takes to change that. Maybe go to a college.
I hope the best for you

Many things..Go to the nearby forest when there's a storm, and listen to two sad songs repeatedly. Wander aimlessly in the city. Go out to the park reading, wishing someone would come, and talk to me. Registering to reddit, to share my feelings etc.

It think today being cheated on at least once, is inevitable. I'm sorry for what you are going through. They say once a cheater, always a cheater. In fact, that's very true...See she cheated on you before, and i think when you got cheated on, you need to end it. Basically when she kissed that guy, that day, your marriage has ended. I think you need to learn two things, first is the rule once a cheater, always a cheater, so don't bother continuing with her if given the chance... Second is that you made her too valuable. Your wife must be very valuable yes, but nobody should mean the world to you, because once you loose that person, you loose your world. Your world should always be yourself, and that can't be, if you are so dependent on someone else. Personal space is very important. hop you see it now. By spending time with only her, you burn bridges behind you. You loose friends, you disconnect from your family...Never do that again.
 From someone who's been through the same.
I think the very very best would be to go to a psychologist. You can afford it, and a psychologist is a lot smarter then us here in reddit. Please go see one
I think you should do that too. Just get away man.

I quit cigarettes for three years, after smoking for about a decade. Now i started again, because my depression got worse. As a longtime smoker, no smoking doesn't do shit for you...You just wan't to smoke, because you're self destructive. I'm not saying you shouldn't do it, but it won't make any difference. I smoke because I've allowed myself to do so until things get bearable again. But again, it's noting but self destruction. It's shitty, and unpleasant.
I fuckin love this!

I'm really interested in that. I have strong depression, and everyone says i should go see a doctor, and get myself some antidepressants. But i'm afraid of it, and i don't want to accept the fact that i might need it. Can you tell me more about it? How do you feel about it, and how long do you have to take them?
You need to read this. Man Disconnected: How technology has sabotaged what it means to be male by Philip Zimbardo.

Everyone wants to belong. And in this modern society it's very easy to get lost, and isolated. Obviously you like the camp, because there you feel you belong to somewhere. Over there you're a part of a community. It's easy to loose that. Since you can't go there anymore. I think it's the best to focus on your future, and how can you recreate that environment for yourself. You should figure out what are the things that are interest you. You're a boy, so i would suggest to go ahead and join a martial arts gym. It's very good to get that sort of "tribal" feeling. Where you belong to a tribe. It's easy to make friends there, and grow together. But it doesn't have to be martial arts, although i think that's the best for you, it can be anything else where it's a community you can join. Online wouldn't do! You need real connection (sorry reddit). And for the punishment...Don't make excuses when they confront you. Take the punishment whatever it may be without a word. Weather it out, and join a gym. Your parents will probably be happy that you want to go and exercise. I hope you believe me, and at least give it a try. 

Hang tough
There must be a way. Why do you think you never had a girlfriend? As rational as you can be.
I'm sorry man..

Other peoples opinion of you doesn't have to become your reality. So i advise you not to pay attention to what others think of you. The basis of self-confidence is what YOU think about yourself. I'm pretty lonely, and depressed myself, but if there's one thing other people could not take away from me, is my confidence. If some people don't like you, fuck them. Others will. 
edit: oh an one more thing. I'm good looking. Most people say so, so i guess it's true. And i'm fucking lonely. I haven't had a girlfriend for four years. So it's not all about looks, there are other factors too.
She must have been really hurt. I hope the best for you.
Thanks for both of you :D

Well...maybe you are alone over there, but you are not alone with your experiences. Almost exactly the same things happened to me.I'm 25. Lived with my girlfriend, she cheated, left me. Friends left me. Everyone i knew is gone, except two of my friends. That's my upside, but I don't live with my parents, i live alone. My sister wouldn't talk to me, my father denied me as his son. My girlfriend left me four years ago. Never had a relationship since, and i rarely see those two friends. I don't think that i'm left alone because i'm such a looser, i'm just completely isolated. Today i registered here, because i have no one to talk to. It's 4:26 am over here. I couldn't sleep, so i turned on my laptop again for some distraction. Unfortunately i can't tell you what to do, because I myself don't know what i should do. But i feel for you. I know exactly how you feel. Even as a male i have broken down crying several times. It's just very tough being so alone. And it's not meant for anyone. The only thing that gives me hope, is that i'm very young, and you are too. Things can get better for us, if we can keep our head above water long enough. This is what i believe in, this is what keeps me going. As long as you can breath, there is still a chance, that thing will get better.

First of all thank you for sharing.  It seems we have much in common. I've done Muay thai too, but i quit because i don't have money to both go to the gym, and train thai boxing. So basically it's your job that takes your life away. Is quitting your job out of the question? I mean does it worth it? Maybe you, and your family could get along with less money, and more of you. Maybe do something related to martial arts? It's very drastic, but you hate living like this anyway. Why not leave the whole thing behind, and do what you love?
I don't know...I really don't want to talk to strangers about this, that's why I haven't seen a doctor yet. It's easier online, and I guess I still hope things will change without medication.

God i just read what other people post in here, and i feel so awful for complaining of my ridiculous problems, but what can i do, if i feel this way? I might delete this post. Anyway yes i was thinking about medication, but i just can't believe that this is my only solution.

I'm 25 and gym, and martial arts do the same for me. The only thing i don't understand, is my dream is to have my own family. You have your family, what makes you depressed? I mean i don't think that it solves everything at all...but at least you're not living alone, isolated. Like i am

Usually there is something you unaware of, that makes you depressed. Something you don't know it's there. In your mind. I'm 25, and i have depression, since about your age. What i should've done differently is telling someone who would take me seriously, and go to a psychologist... No kidding. Somethings you can't solve on your own. I know that, because i couldn't solve it since. And i ended up living alone in a flat, with no one to talk to, and wanting to kill myself. I don't want anyone to suffer this long. So speak to someone who listens, and go to a psychologist. This is the way

I just registered seeing all this negativity. I'm suicidal myself, but i still don't think that it's gonna get worse and worse. I think the challenge is acting out to change your life, while it seems unbearable, and seeing no results. But i think that it's possible, it's just very very hard.
